title.zh: XRP falls hard after CLARITY vote as Ripple’s regulatory advantage faces a new test
title.en: XRP falls hard after CLARITY vote as Ripple’s regulatory advantage faces a new test

current_state.zh: XRP dropped over 8% after the Senate blocked a motion to advance the CLARITY Act, delaying a US market-structure framework even as XRP's existing regulatory treatment as a digital commodity remains unchanged.
current_state.en: XRP dropped over 8% after the Senate blocked a motion to advance the CLARITY Act, delaying a US market-structure framework even as XRP's existing regulatory treatment as a digital commodity remains unchanged.
